# 1. Introduction

## 1.1 Git

Git is a version control system that tracks changes in your files and allows you to revert back, collaborate with others, and maintain a clean history of development. It's especially helpful for coding and data science projects. In short, it solves the following issues: \* what if an older version was better? \* how can I share code ? \* how can I collaborate
